info.title: Modbot API
info.description:
Cached VRChat group data, moderation history and analytics for a single group.

This is one self-hosted deployment's API. There is no central Modbot service and no shared endpoint: you are talking to somebody's own server, at the address they host it on.

**Signing in.** A program sends an API key as `Authorization: Bearer mbk_...`. The key acts as the person who made it, with the permissions chosen for the key and never more than that person holds now. The web app uses the `modbot.session` cookie instead. Both are refused for an account that is disabled or has not linked its VRChat account.

**Errors** usually carry a JSON body with one field, `error`, saying what went wrong in a sentence.

API version 1 (oldest still supported: 1). The API version is a plain number, separate from the release version, and goes up only on a breaking change.

address.description: The address your Modbot is hosted at.

post.summary: Start a session
post.description:
The username field takes an email address or a username; both are matched case-insensitively.

Returns 401 for any failed attempt without saying why. Distinguishing "no such user" from "wrong password" would turn the login form into a way to enumerate staff accounts, and answering differently for an address would turn it into a way to find out who has an account here.

get.summary: The live updates WebSocket
get.description: Authenticate with `?ticket=` from POST /api/live/tickets, or `Authorization: Bearer mbk_...`. `?after=` is the cursor to carry on from; without it the stream starts from now. Events arrive as `{"kind":"event","event":{...}}`. See https://docs.modbot.co/api/live-updates/.

get.summary: Long polling for live updates, the backup for the WebSocket
get.description: Returns events after `after` at once when there are any, up to `limit` (default 100, at most 500); otherwise waits up to `wait` seconds (default 30, at most 60) for one and returns an empty list. No `after` means from now. Send the returned `cursor` back as `after`; `more` means poll again straight away. See https://docs.modbot.co/api/live-updates/.

get.summary: Long polling for the live event stream
get.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer mbk_...`. No cursor means from now. Send the returned `cursor` back; `more` means poll again straight away. `types` and `subjects` repeat or are comma-separated. See https://docs.modbot.co/api/long-polling/.

get.summary: Forward a GET to VRChat
get.description: Sends the request to `https://api.vrchat.cloud/{path}` and answers with VRChat's status, body and the headers that matter. With a Modbot API key -- in the `Authorization` header, or as the value of a cookie named `auth`, which is where a VRChat client library puts it -- the request goes out as the group's service account. With anything else in the `auth` cookie it goes out with your own cookies, as you. Needs the `UseVRChatProxy` permission for the service account. Answers 404 while the proxy is switched off, 429 when Modbot's own pacing has stopped the proxy, and 503 when Modbot cannot reach VRChat at all.

get.summary: A picture or video from VRChat
get.description: Fetches a VRChat file address through Modbot and returns the bytes. VRChat's file addresses need the account's session cookie and redirect to a delivery host, so a browser cannot load one directly. Only addresses on vrchat.cloud are accepted, only pictures and video are returned, and the answer is cached on disk because a VRChat file address names a version and never changes.

post.summary: Upload old data and start importing it
post.description:
The body is the file: a JSON array of records, or one record per line. Send it as the body with Content-Type application/json and the source as a query parameter, or as a multipart form with a file part and a source field. At most 64 MB. The import runs in the background; ask GET /api/imports/{id} how it is going. dryRun=true reads and counts without writing anything. The format is documented at docs.modbot.co/self-hosting/importing-old-data.

Needs the `ManageSettings` permission.

get.summary: The Discord server's members, current and past, with search
get.description:
Members in the server by default; `state=left` shows people who left, `state=all` both. `search` matches the display name, username, global name, nickname and the id, case-insensitively. `role` is a Discord role id and may be repeated: people holding any of them. `notRole`, also repeatable, leaves out people holding any of those; `noRole=true` keeps only people with no role. `bot`, `pending`, `timedOut` and `boosting` are true or false. `joinedFrom` and `joinedTo` narrow to people who joined inside that stretch. `linked=linked` shows only people with a linked VRChat account and `linked=not-linked` only people without; both need See profiles, as does `linkedVRChat` on each member. Newest joiners first unless `sort=oldest` or `sort=name`. `roles` lists the server's roles with how many current members hold each.

`coverage.listedAt` is null until the bot has read the whole member list once; the list is partial until then.

Needs the `ViewMembers` permission.

get.summary: The merged fact timeline: who did what to whom, and when

The two are separate permissions and the filter is applied server-side on every query: asking for a type you cannot see omits it rather than refusing the request.

Facts carry occurredAt and, when the time is an inference rather than a statement, occurredBefore. `precision` says which, so a window is never rendered as an instant.

`world` and `instance` narrow to one world or one VRChat instance number; `category` to Moderation or Operational; `precision` to Exact or Window; `hasActor` to facts somebody is named for, or not; `q` finds a word in the payload, the subject id or the actor id.

get.summary: One case file: reasons, the written reason, the evidence, and the profile at the time
get.description:
`evidence` is null unless the caller holds ViewEvidence. `snapshot.explanation` says when the profile was captured and how old it was then; the snapshot never changes afterwards except for the one permitted recapture, which `snapshot.canCaptureAgain` offers when a fresher profile has arrived. `evidenceDelivery` repeats what the Settings evidence card says about how bytes travel, so the attach control can say the same thing.

Needs the `ViewProfile` permission.

put.description: The author, or anyone who may ban. The change is a fact carrying before and after, so the edit history reads back from the log alone. The profile snapshot and the evidence are not touched by this.

post.summary: Mark a case file withdrawn, with a note
post.description: Case files are never deleted. A withdrawn one stays readable, stops counting as the write-up of its ban, and cannot be edited again -- write a new one instead.

401.description: Not signed in, or the API key is not valid.

post.summary: Take the profile snapshot again, once, after a fresher profile has arrived
post.description: Allowed once per case file, and only when VRChat has answered with a newer profile since the snapshot was taken. The snapshot it replaces is kept in full in the fact that records this, so the first capture is never lost.

401.description: Not signed in, or the API key is not valid.

post.summary: Remove a person from the group
post.description:
Nothing is recorded as done unless VRChat accepted it. A reason is optional unless the group has asked for one. The key makes one confirmation act once: send the same key again and you get the first answer back, not a second kick.

Needs the `Kick` permission.

401.description: Not signed in, or the API key is not valid.

post.summary: Ban a person from the group
post.description:
A reason is required, and the ban's case file is written from it and the note. Nothing is recorded as done unless VRChat accepted it. The key makes one confirmation act once.

Needs the `Ban` permission.

post.summary: Lift a person's ban
post.description:
Nothing is recorded as done unless VRChat accepted it. A reason is optional unless the group has asked for one. The key makes one confirmation act once.

Needs the `Unban` permission.
